Notes on the target service, held items and ledger checks:

- A held item (X1 to X5, X9) and a refused attach (X10 to X12, X14) store no document and write no DOCATT entry; the hold is the match_status on the intake item in `rwb_document` (GAP-2446).

- The per-service database login is the rwb-decision login (DP-02). Parameter names: Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2449), read through the rwb-case parameters contract. Texts of MSG-P7-009 and MSG-GEN-006: Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2449).

- The ledger completeness check, which compares the documents of a case with the DOCATT entries of that case, runs on the ledger ingest window of DP-06, with no Temporal Schedule and no cron entry of this service (GAP-2450).

- The partner submission of an instruction is carried on screen PRT-02 Instruction (FSD S9); the service answer of this story is unchanged (GAP-3145).
